requirement: Each completed wire byte (8 MSB-first bits sampled on physical SCL rises inside START..STOP) equals the next enqueued, unflushed FMT byte; wire START presence before the byte equals its START flag.
A STOP follows a STOP-flagged byte before any further START or committed data bit; no STOP without STOP flag outside halt handling.
assumption: STOP setup rise is not a data bit (pending-bit decoder)

requirement: FMT head (byte/flags/depth) matches model while valid; pop (ready&valid) only after that entry's byte appeared on the wire.
Physical bus equals scl_pin&!stretch and sda_pin&!target_low.
Controller does not drive SCL/SDA low during reset.
Unexpected NACK (not NAKOK): after ninth SCL fall, no SCL release, data bit, START or byte until software clear (or timeout/disable STOP).
assumption: halt anchored after ACK falling edge

requirement: With NACK timeout, STOP is generated and the bus stays released until software clears.
assumption: no exact timeout cycle count checked

requirement: Events stretch_recovery, nak_restart, nak_timeout_recovery credited only with clean failure-free windows, witnessed status (nak/sticky, timeout), complete correct byte and STOP.
NACK on NAKOK byte is an expected event, not a defect.
